submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 gives the highest signal efficiency at the 8 kHz allocated rate. Its scan peaks at 93.1% at 34 GeV. The runner-up, Algorithm-L3, peaks at 86.2% at 35 GeV, and Algorithm-L1 reaches about 74%. L2's lead of about 7 points is well above the estimated noise of 1.5%. L2's efficiency is fairly flat between 30 and 43 GeV, at roughly 90–93%, so the choice of 34 GeV is not sensitive to small shifts. The optimum is not on the edge of the 20–60 GeV range. No rate, threshold-range or deployability conflicts were found, and no candidates were ruled out. I did not see the emulation caveats or the rate-per-threshold data directly. I am relying on the recorded counts of conflicts (all zero) for those checks.

requirements.requirement: Highest signal efficiency at allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: L2 at 34 GeV gives 93.1%, against 86.2% for L3 and about 74% for L1. The recorded rate conflicts count is 0.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm is one of three candidates
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 is one of the 3 candidates.
The recorded deployability conflicts count is 0 and no candidates were ruled out.
The threshold is 34 GeV and the optimum is not on the edge of the range.
